description: Pinned alpha promotion lifecycle policy (iap.lifecycle; RESEARCH -> CANDIDATE -> VALIDATING -> PAPER -> ACTIVE -> WATCH -> RETIRED). The promotion gate thresholds equal the spec section 20 gates pinned in iap.validation.validate.GATES; the ACTIVE/WATCH/RETIRED rules are NOT duplicated here — they stay in strategies.json adaptive.lifecycle and are reused unchanged. Every number is a threshold a port must reproduce exactly; tests/golden/expected_lifecycle.json embeds the merged config.
